metaShifts.description: This patch systematically nerfs farming acceleration tools that have dominated the meta. Hand of Midas attack speed reduction, Heart of Tarrasque cost increase, and neutral item mana nerfs (Occult Bracelet, Tumbler's Toy) all target fast-farming strategies. Combined with Enigma's reduced Eidolon bounty and Sven's damage nerfs, this represents a clear shift away from accelerated farming patterns toward more measured economic progression.

Continuing 7.34c's support redistribution but with a focus on utility over raw power. Eul's cost reduction makes it more accessible for supports, while heroes like Witch Doctor receive nuanced changes (base strength up, Death Ward mixed adjustments). Ogre Magi gets substantial buffs to Bloodlust and cast ranges, emphasizing support impact through utility rather than damage. This amplifies the previous patch's support rebalancing trend.

After 7.34c began empowering ranged carries, this patch continues that trend while simultaneously nerfing dominant melee carries. Sven faces comprehensive nerfs (base damage and God's Strength), while agility carries like Phantom Assassin receive mixed adjustments and Spectre gets mobility buffs. Anti-Mage receives minor buffs, suggesting a preference for mobile, late-game oriented carries over early-fighting strength heroes.

Building on 7.34c's Invoker containment, this patch further nerfs spell-based mid dominance. Invoker receives additional nerfs (health regen, EMP mana restoration), while heroes like Pugna get building damage buffs and Luna faces glaive damage reductions. This continues the trend of reducing spell-caster mid lane dominance while promoting more balanced, less oppressive mid lane options.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Eul's cost reduction (2725→2625) makes this core utility item more accessible for supports like Ogre Magi (who also received cast range buffs), creating a synergistic effect where supports can afford key utility items earlier while having improved abilities to utilize them effectively.

Anti-Mage's buffs (armor +1, Mana Void cost reduction) combined with nerfs to farming acceleration tools (Midas, Heart cost increases) create a favorable environment where his natural farming efficiency and late-game scaling become more valuable relative to accelerated farming strategies.

Weaver's Shukuchi and Geminate Attack damage buffs synergize with the overall nerf to defensive items (Heart cost increase, Blade Mail damage reduction), creating an environment where his harassment and kill potential in lane becomes significantly more threatening.

Ogre's substantial Bloodlust buffs (attack speed increases across all levels) combined with improved cast ranges create powerful synergies with attack speed-dependent carries, especially as farming acceleration items are nerfed, making Bloodlust's scaling more valuable.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Sven's comprehensive nerfs (base damage -4, God's Strength damage reduction) combined with increased costs for farming items (Heart +100 gold, Midas attack speed nerf) severely impact his ability to accelerate into late-game dominance, as his farming efficiency and scaling are both diminished.

Invoker's health regen nerf and EMP mana restoration reduction (50%→25%) combined with neutral item mana nerfs (Occult Bracelet, Tumbler's Toy) create a compounding sustainability crisis, making his laning phase significantly more vulnerable.

Luna's Moon Glaives damage reduction per bounce nerf combined with farming acceleration item nerfs (Midas, neutral mana items) reduces both her farming speed and teamfight effectiveness, creating a double impact on her core strengths.

Nature's Prophet's base strength reduction and Sprout cooldown increase combined with Blade Mail damage nerf (reducing his counter-initiation fear) makes his early game significantly weaker while removing some of his defensive options.

Carry.explanation: Base armor increase and Mana Void cost reduction improve his laning survivability and late-game teamfight presence. Benefits significantly from the farming acceleration nerfs as his natural farming efficiency becomes more valuable relative to item-dependent acceleration strategies.

Substantial damage buffs to both Shukuchi (100/130/160/190) and Geminate Attack create significantly higher harassment and kill potential in lane. The nerf to defensive items like Heart and Blade Mail makes his burst damage more threatening.

Shadow Step cooldown reduction (80/60/40→60/50/40) improves her mobility and teamfight presence. Benefits from the slower farming meta as her natural late-game scaling becomes more valuable when farming acceleration is nerfed.

Feast damage increase (0.8/1.1/1.4/1.7%→1/1.3/1.6/1.9%) significantly improves his laning against strength heroes and late-game tank-busting capability, while the Heart cost increase makes his percentage-based damage more valuable.

Mid.explanation: Nether Blast building damage increase (50%→65%) and Decrepify improvements (cast range and slow buffs) enhance his tower-pushing capability and teamfight control. Benefits from the spell-caster mid stabilization as he's less oppressive than Invoker.

Powershot reduction per unit decrease (20%→15%) improves her wave clear and harassment efficiency. The farming acceleration nerfs favor her natural laning strength and utility-based scaling over raw damage acceleration.

Offlane.explanation: Slithereen Crush cooldown reduction (8s→7s) improves his initiation frequency and farming speed. Benefits from the teamfight-oriented meta shift as his utility and lockdown become more valuable.

Greater Bash movement speed damage increase (20/25/30/35%→25/30/35/40%) significantly improves his damage output. The farming acceleration nerfs favor his natural roaming and fighting playstyle over farming-focused offlaners.

Whirling Death damage increase (80/120/160/200→85/130/175/220) improves his laning harass and teamfight damage. Benefits from the slower farming meta as his natural sustain and area damage become more valuable.

SoftSupport.explanation: Comprehensive buffs to Fireblast cast range (475→525), Bloodlust attack speed increases, and Unrefined Fireblast range create significantly more impact potential. The Eul's cost reduction also benefits his item progression.
Splinter Blast projectile speed increase (650→750) and Winter's Curse duration buffs improve both her laning harass and teamfight control. Benefits from the utility-focused support meta.

HardSupport.explanation: Base strength increase (+2) improves his survivability, while Death Ward damage buffs maintain his teamfight impact despite cooldown increases. The mixed adjustments favor skilled positioning over raw power.

Intelligence and intelligence gain buffs combined with Aphotic Shield damage barrier increases create significantly better laning presence and mana sustainability. Benefits from the utility support renaissance.

Carry.explanation: Comprehensive nerfs with base damage reduction (-4) and God's Strength damage decrease (120/160/200%→100/140/180%) severely impact his farming speed and teamfight damage. The farming acceleration item nerfs compound his weakened state.

Moon Glaives damage reduction per bounce nerf (56/50/44/38%→50/45/40/35%) reduces her farming efficiency and teamfight damage output. The farming acceleration nerfs make her slower farming particularly problematic.

Mid.explanation: Base health regen reduction (1→0.5) and EMP mana restoration nerf (50%→25%) significantly weaken his laning sustainability and teamfight impact. Combined with neutral item mana nerfs, his resource management becomes critically strained.

Offlane.explanation: Base strength reduction (21→19) and Sprout cooldown increase (12/11/10/9→15/13/11/9) weaken both his survivability and escape/initiation capability. The farming acceleration nerfs also impact his split-push effectiveness.

Base armor reduction (-1) and Hawk root duration nerf (1s→0.25/0.5/0.75/1s at early levels) significantly weaken his laning presence and early game control, which are crucial for his role as an offlaner.

SoftSupport.explanation: Magic Missile cooldown increase (12/11/10/9→15/13/11/9) and Wave of Terror damage reduction nerf (15/20/25/30%→10/15/20/25%) significantly reduce her early game impact and teamfight utility.

Mana cost increases for both Swashbuckle and Shield Crash, combined with Shield Crash damage reduction (70/140/210/280→60/120/180/240), severely impact his laning sustainability and teamfight effectiveness.

HardSupport.explanation: Base damage reduction (-2), mana regen decrease (-0.25), and talent nerfs across multiple levels weaken his laning presence and scaling potential. The farming acceleration nerfs don't benefit his playstyle.
